_doc: Reference rows `mise run triage` files as known: differences the repository already explains, so a triage lists only what is left to look at. `build` is a fragment of the build folder's name (or a synthetic skill-sweep case id), `xml_sha256`, when present, binds an entry to the exact decoded UTF-8 XML so short rank names cannot match another snapshot; `stats` the rows it explains, `reason` where the explanation is. Synthetic case entries document sweep findings; skill-sweep does not yet consume this registry. Add an entry when a difference is documented as deliberate; remove it when the engine changes.

ActiveSkills.Description defines Physical Attack damage independent of weapons; game types Attack/NonWeaponAttack and no global_always_hit require accuracy. Level 20 base damage is 196–294 × 4.08, crit 5%; pinned PoB2 skips the accuracy and critical confirmation checks (docs/maintainer-guide.md, event-triggered hits). The existing 1/s presentation is not a model of blood loss, heavy stun or death events.

The hit is already calculated (level 20: 128–192 physical × 2.04); ActiveSkills.Description requires hitting a cursed enemy. Event rate is unmodelled: PoBR reports average_damage and zero DPS; PoB2 puts average hit into CombinedDPS and skips the attack accuracy check (docs/maintainer-guide.md, event-triggered hits).

The hit is already calculated (level 20: 85–128 plus 5–7 per complete 15 shield Armour, all × 2.04); ActiveSkills.Description triggers it when subsequent shield attacks deal damage.
